gemmaContribution.result: Rejected qualitative/schema boundary; deterministic fallback retained. Structured input and raw output in full-lap-gemma-validation.json.

method: One continuous calibrated point-mass lap; signed section attribution; no external lap record or desired gain target.

assumptions: 2D point mass on the recorded path; no downforce, banking, grade, tire temperature or mass identification. No absolute grip or engine limit is inferred from driver demand.

Separate 2 m/s propulsion and braking bands with median/MAD upper-outlier rejection from nonoverlapping 0.4 s windows. Bands need three observations; interpolate interior gaps, hold nearest supported capability at outer speeds. Combined-demand correction uses lateral utilization below 0.8 only.

Scenario limits use sustained 80th/98th percentile directional demand and 97th/99.5th percentile lateral demand. Maximum speed uses 99th/99.9th percentile recorded speed; power above that support remains unknown. No arbitrary performance uplift.
Section baselines use measured elapsed times; optimized times integrate the speed solution. Baseline speed-integral minus recorded duration is reported separately as alignment/integration residual.

Cyclic forward/backward reachability uses maximum endpoint lateral demand throughout each cell and a friction ellipse; every section includes entry/exit and downstream speed consequences. Section gains stay signed and partition one lap.

RPM/gear/throttle identification is insufficient for a reliable shift map; No explicit shift model; short interruptions and mandatory shift losses may be underrepresented by sustained upper-tail demand. No separate shift-saving or RPM recovery is attributed.

Calibration uses 477 sustained windows on 7 training laps; geometry chord 10.0 m; primary-path wider-chord curvature sensitivity retained (no geometry averaging across physically unaligned lap distances). 3 heldout laps excluded from capability fitting.
rpmEvidence: No reliable gear/shift identification; mandatory shift losses may be underrepresented; no separate shifting gain attributed.

gainRange.method: Signed disjoint cell-time differences from two continuous cyclic combined-grip solutions. Quantile scenarios are sensitivity bounds, not confidence intervals.
